business_summary: Longyan Kaolin Clay Co., Ltd. engages in production and supply of kaolin for ceramic raw materials in China. The company provides kaolin raw ore, 325-mesh kaolin concentrate, super longyan kaolin, modified kaolin, and comprehensive utilization products. Its products are used in ceramics, papermaking, rubber, ink, coatings, chemicals, and other fields. The company also exports its products to South Korea, Japan, Pakistan, South Africa, and Southeast Asia. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Longyan, China. Longyan Kaolin Clay Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Longyan Investment & Development Group Co.,Ltd.
